profile.subtitleJa: ソロモンが犠牲をささげた高き所のある町
profile.summaryJa: 列王記上3:4–5では、王がギブオンへ行き、大きな高き所で犠牲をささげたと記されます。本文はその祭壇の正確な遺構位置を特定しません。
profile.modernLocationJa: 古代の町。礼拝地点の特定位置と市域は区別して扱います。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
In Gibeon, the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
The LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
